units.title: Building a Real Project
units.blurb: Power, testing and a ladder of projects.

units.title: Careers
units.blurb: What the work is, how people get there, and honest timelines.

topics.title: Power Budgets and Battery Life
topics.short: Add up the current of every part; battery life is about capacity ÷ current, less a safety margin.
topics.trouble: Students forget the motors' current, which is usually most of it, or run a battery right down to empty.

topics.title: Design, Build, Test, Repeat
topics.short: Change one thing at a time, run several trials, and record the success rate honestly.
topics.trouble: Students change three things at once and can't tell which one helped.

topics.title: Robotics Careers and Honest Timelines
topics.short: Most robotics engineers hold an engineering degree; technicians often start with two years of training. A portfolio of finished projects helps at every level.
topics.trouble: Learners believe a six-month course alone leads to an engineering job title.
